message: Add my laptop so you can control it.
comment: MIRRORS the S47 walk's second question (spec s47 §13) and hub-topology's S47 DoD. WHAT IS MEASURED: that she SENDS the pairing card instead of reciting a code she does not have. tool_called('show_setup_qr') is a span, so a well-written answer with no card scores false. guard_absent('code_claim') catches a pairing code written into her reply: she never holds one — it goes to the card only — so any code in her text is invented, and five wrong codes lock every enroll for fifteen minutes (spec §7). guard_absent('narration') catches 'here's a QR code' with no card sent. guard_absent('capability_claim') catches 'I can't pair a machine' with show_setup_qr in her hands. tool_called, not tool_succeeded: a hub with no address another device can reach is an honest refusal. WHAT IT CANNOT MEASURE: whether the laptop runs the command; the walk's enroll is that check. Every case runs under the pairing fixture, so no real code is minted. Added 2026-09-25 with the S47 corpus bump (15 -> 16).
